exports.description: List of NFS export entries to configure.

clients.description: List of client specifications (e.g., IP addresses, hostnames, networks, or special keywords like 'sync' clients).

items.description: A client specification, optionally with options in parentheses. Example: '192.168.1.0/24(rw,sync,no_subtree_check)' or 'host.example.com(ro)'.
